headline: US Lawmakers Propose Ban on DUV Chipmaking and Etching Tools to Key Chinese Firms
summary: This bipartisan legislative proposal marks a significant escalation in the US-China tech trade war, directly targeting China's ability to produce advanced semiconductors by restricting access to critical DUV lithography equipment. Such a ban would severely impact semiconductor fabs in China, reshape AI infrastructure development, and further fragment global supply chains for advanced technology.
